topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Just found out my apartment building is going condo. Great, just what I needed. Now I have to deal with all the changes and uncertainties. The rent's already high, and now I have to worry about buying or moving out. I don’t have the luxury of suddenly coming up with a down payment. And finding a new place? Good luck with that in this market. The landlord’s probably lining his pockets while we all scramble. I’m not the only one feeling this way; the whole building’s buzzing with unrest. Just what a Monday needed.
